title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: Kotlin Jump 1.25.0 adds hover tooltips that explain Android permissions directly in your code and in AndroidManifest.xml.

highlights.title: Permission Hover Details
highlights.description: Hovering an Android permission, whether a Manifest.permission constant, a permission string, or an entry in AndroidManifest.xml, now shows its protection level and a plain-language explanation of what it grants.

sections.heading: Improvements
bullets: Added hover tooltips for Android permissions covering 61 permissions, showing the protection level (normal, dangerous, or signature) and a plain-language description without leaving the editor.
Included migration notes on legacy permissions such as WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, BLUETOOTH, and USE_FINGERPRINT, clarifying how they behave on newer Android versions.
Extended hover support to AndroidManifest.xml, so permission entries there get the same tooltips as permission references in Kotlin code.
